strings.en: Well, well, shall we give it a go?
Not being allowed to overdo it is such a pain.
Well, well, work, work.
Here I come.
Let's have a match§
Fouuund you.
Oh my, so that's where you were.
Is meeting me good luck or bad?/　That's up to you.
Feel free to hate me, okay?
Ufufu, I can see right through you, in every way§
Aha, wanna test your luck?
I won't hold back much, okay?
Truth is, we've been making a few of these.
Here I come, little Privy Council errand boy.
Working hard out in the boonies/　won't get you promoted.
And I told you not to get serious.
Defecting to Earth's side? You've got some nerve.
Isn't a traitor's fate/　the same on every planet?
Quite the bold girl, aren't you, Sally dear?
Weak defenses for a mothership.
I have to be careful not to break the prize.
Oh my,/　you won't turn into Neo Granzon for me?
Hurry up and go Neo already.
The rumored Neo Granzon. How brawny.
Something's off about it,/　but that's a Masoukishin, right?
Better watch out for the Cyflash.
That unit's engine is fascinating.
The budget version of the Hückebein Boxer.
Gonna vanish on me?
I wonder if it has the power/　of the Hückebein Mk-III?
Ufufu, so that's the newest Hückebein.
Flashy paint job. Because it's a prototype?
Looks like it's been quietly powered up.
So that's where the Siebe Drive I was after is./　Not that I need it anymore.
Fitting a Siebe Drive as a stopgap measure/　is quite the idea, I must say.
I know that unit/　isn't purely made on Earth.
Now, counterattack.
Oh my? You're still there?
That slow judgment will be the death of you.
You struck first, so anything goes, right?
Well, well, what shall I do with you?
Ufu, you took the bait.
Next time, I'd like to fight in a better unit.
Hmm, I messed up.
What am I going to tell Gomoudokka...?
Oh my, my, my.
If I take any more hits, I'll be in trouble too.
Hmm... Maybe I'll ask for a raise.
You're really getting on my nerves.
Well, well, what should I do?
My life won't come cheap, you know?
So that's the power you've used/　to beat all kinds of enemies.
I'd better start planning my escape.
Ouch... This isn't worth the pay.
You want your master to praise you that badly?
Aren't you more fired up/　than you were with Gadisword?
So ruthless./　No wonder poor Quepalok got killed.
At this point it's less a gale and more a storm.
This spot's really not in my favor...
Ouch... I need to rip off that module.
Oh my, this is pretty good.
Not as good as the rumors... Just thought I'd say it.
I may not look it, but I hold grudges.
Ufufu, how should I repay you?
...Well, it was never going to be easy.
As expected, you're used to fighting.
Tell me more about the secret of that strength.
Yes, this is getting fun.
I'm not scared of the Privy Council.
Picking a fight with Golaikunru won't do you any good.
Yes, yes. That's what I wanted to see.
Neo Granzon... Thrilling, in more ways than one.
You think a stopgap modification will do the trick?
Not bad, Cybuster.
Even against a budget model,/　I need to watch out up close.
So the Mk-III know-how lives on.
Get cocky and you'll be erased, okay?
Oh? I hit it.
Well, this much is a given.
Ufufu, nice moves.
Hey, wanna come work for us?
Kind of a letdown.
Fufu, how sweet of you.
Being dedicated to your work is a good thing.
Get serious. Okay?
It's sad when hard work doesn't pay off, isn't it?
Oh my, so what did you betray them for?
It's creepy how unimpressive this is.
That's all Neo's got? Meanie.
Is that Siebe Drive working properly?
Fufu, what a cool breeze.
All that stuff bolted on, is it just for show?
Aren't you wasting that module's power?
Oh my, even the budget model's nimble.
As expected of the newest model. It's got something.
Oh my, you have to aim really carefully.
Ufufu, call it a woman's intuition.
Well, well, what trick is next, I wonder?
If it hit me... well, that'd be awful, right?
Too bad.
That kind of thing won't work.
I had this ready for you.
Okaaay, good work.
Ufufu, bye-bye!
And I aimed so carefully.
Oh? Did I miscalculate?
I see. Maybe I'll think of another plan.
Lucky you, you survived.
Oh my, you're quick to run.
Hmm, so that's what you're gonna do.
Oh well. I'll go after another unit.
I won't miss the juicy part.
Thought it was over? Too bad.
Still a long way to go, Kinaha dear.
Gomoudokka, leave it to me.
Bilgo dear, I'll lend you a hand.
Well, well, I need to buy some time.
This is all part of the job.
Hellooo, mind if I butt in?
That unit's no ordinary one.
I've got to do my best for my boss too.
I can't have Herluga beaten just yet.
Aha, my chance§
This one's on the house§
Here goes!
Hit them!
Mine§
Take this.
Just the right spot§
Here you go!
Will you take this?
Please hit§
Hyaah!
Hup!
Okaaay, there!
There might not be a trace left.
Guess I'll use the Giga Blaster.
Okaaay, here you go!
I've already got you in my sights.
Fire§
This'll hurt!
Can you get away?
Here, take this, okay?
Take it while it's hot!
I'll crush you all at once§
It won't hit my allies. Probably.
Take it while it's hot.
Wanna taste Baran-Schneil's/　full power?
This weapon came from Earth. Did you know?
Aha, I caught you.
And so, bye-byeee!
For you, who can't move,/　a very special present§
Ready, set, kaboom!
